# Bommaku Group — The Pavillion Project Facts

## Company
Bommaku Group Private Limited
Real estate developer
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

## Flagship Project
The Pavillion
Luxury standalone villa community
Surya Hills, Boduppal, East Hyderabad

## Location
Surya Hills, Boduppal, Hyderabad, Telangana 500039
Coordinates: 17.416403, 78.575600
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/3gEbRXmKsENAkjXi7

## Project Details
- 40 luxury standalone villas
- Configuration: G+1+Penthouse (3 floors)
- Type: 3 BHK + Pooja Room
- Plot sizes: 150 Sq. Yds to 250 Sq. Yds
- Built-up area: 2,200 - 2,500 SFT per villa
- Type A dimensions: 30 × 45 ft
- Total site area: 3 acres
- 100% Vastu compliant
- No shared walls (standalone villas)
- Private compound wall and gate for each villa
- Covered parking included
- Home theatre on penthouse level

## Pricing
Starting from ₹1.87 Crore (₹18,700,000)
Range: ₹1.87 Cr to ₹2.4 Cr depending on plot size and customization

## Recreation Zone
Bommaku Recreation Zone: 24,000 SFT
Exclusively for 40 families (750 SFT per family)
Facilities include:
- Swimming pool & infinity pool
- Fully equipped gym
- Yoga room & meditation deck
- Sauna & steam room
- Sports courts (football, pickleball, cricket practice net)
- Restaurant & cafe
- Children's play area
- Zen garden & landscaped gardens
- 24x7 security

Membership: First year free for owners, 35% benefit from year 2 onwards

## Unique Features
"The Clean Slate" — buyer personalization program
Customize internal layouts, elevations, and room configurations before construction

## Approvals & Registration
GP Layout Project (no RERA/HMDA registration applicable for plotted developments)
Bank loan approved by: SBI, ICICI, HDFC, Bajaj Finance, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Karur Vysya Bank
